Selection clipboard fixtures
============================
These small geometry fixtures were created for this project and are distributed
under MIT OR Apache-2.0, like the project tests.

MaskInput.json: generated by examples/selection_clipboard_probe.rs. A 17x13
canvas contains an elliptical ring encoded as merged rectangle polygons.
MaskNativeCopied.json: pasted into the native Windows editor 5.1.12, then copied
back using its selection-geometry clipboard command on 2026-10-25. The clipboard
text preserves all selected pixels. Native history confirmed Paste Selection.
MaskNativeInverted.json: the same selection inverted in the native editor and
copied back. Its raster mask must be the exact complement on the 17x13 canvas.
